summary.text: Mike Olcott is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 60 who has represented the district since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a research scientist.

paragraphs.text: Mike Olcott was born in Fort Worth, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Rhodes College and a Ph.D. from the University of Kentucky.
His career experience includes working as a research scientist.
Olcott served as Parker County Republican Precinct Chair from 2014 to 2021 and co-founded Parker County Conservatives.
Olcott took office on January 14, 2025, succeeding Glenn Rogers.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Krissy Guess in the general election.
